---
title: "Talks"
description: "Talks, workshops, and presentations."
listing:
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  fields: [date, title, description, categories]
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
  freeze: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
.talk-upcoming-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #C2542D;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
</style>
<script>
// Badge talks whose day hasn't passed yet. Each listing item carries its
// date (midnight UTC, in ms) in data-listing-date-sort, so the badge
// switches itself off after the talk without a rebuild.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var now = Date.now();
  document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post[data-listing-date-sort]").forEach(function (post) {
    var day = Number(post.getAttribute("data-listing-date-sort"));
    if (!day || day + 86400000 <= now) return;
    var title = post.querySelector(".listing-title");
    if (!title) return;
    var badge = document.createElement("span");
    badge.className = "talk-upcoming-badge";
    badge.textContent = "Upcoming";
    title.appendChild(badge);
  });
});
</script>
```
